Answer:
The 2023 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine was awarded jointly to Katalin Karikó and Drew Weissman [2]. The prize recognized their discoveries concerning nucleoside base modifications that enabled the development of effective mRNA vaccines against COVID-19 [3]. Their work used modified RNA for therapeutic treatments [1]. This enabled the development of life-saving COVID-19 RNA vaccines by Pfizer-BioNTech [1]. Moderna also developed a life-saving COVID-19 RNA vaccine based on this work [1].
